launcher.title: AI tools
launcher.empty: No AI tool matches your search.
launcher.needsRange: Mark an in and out point first

magicBlur.label: Magic blur
magicBlur.description: Follow an object you name and blur, pixelate or highlight it.

cleanVoice.label: Clean voice
cleanVoice.description: Make speech clearer by taking out background noise.

cleanupAudio.label: Clean up audio
cleanupAudio.description: Remove hum, wind, hiss, echo or music, or isolate the voice. The clean version follows your edits. Basic is free, Studio costs credits.

removeSilence.label: Remove silence
removeSilence.description: Cut the quiet gaps out of your clips.

cutToMusic.label: Cut to the music
cutToMusic.description: Find the beat of a song and cut, split or fit your clips to it.

analyseFootage.label: Analyse footage
analyseFootage.description: Find silences, shots, motion and speech in your media.

editByTranscript.label: Edit by transcript
editByTranscript.description: Cut and rearrange by editing the words that were said.

suggestRecut.label: Suggest a re-cut
suggestRecut.description: Removes, trims or disables clips that drag.

suggestGraphics.label: Suggest graphics
suggestGraphics.description: Adds titles and lower thirds over clips.

suggestGrade.label: Suggest a colour look
suggestGrade.description: Proposes a look for your clips that you can edit.

suggestSoundEffects.label: Suggest sound effects
suggestSoundEffects.description: Places sound files from your project at the cuts.

suggestReview.label: Review my edit
suggestReview.description: Leaves timecoded notes as markers and changes nothing else.

checkLoudness.label: Check loudness
checkLoudness.description: Measure the mix against a target such as social or broadcast.

listenToMix.label: Listen to the mix
listenToMix.description: Play the finished mix to hear how it sounds.

preview3s.label: 3-second preview
preview3s.description: Render a short preview of the picture at the playhead.

did.cut: {count, plural, one {cut # spoken passage} other {cut # spoken passages}} ({seconds, number, ::.0} s)
did.quiet: {count, plural, one {cut # silence} other {cut # silences}} ({seconds, number, ::.0} s)
did.fillers: {count, plural, one {cut # filler word} other {cut # filler words}} ({seconds, number, ::.0} s)
did.lines: {count, plural, one {cut # line} other {cut # lines}} ({seconds, number, ::.0} s)
did.keep: {count, plural, one {kept only the chosen lines, cutting # stretch} other {kept only the chosen lines, cutting # stretches}} ({seconds, number, ::.0} s)
did.other: {count, plural, one {# other change} other {# other changes}}

recut.tooManyCuts: “{label}”: this suggestion has too many cuts to apply at once ({count}). Mark a shorter range and ask again.
recut.swapsRefused: Skipped changes that did not match your request.
